note.summary:
2.2 Customs, festivals and celebrations
Key focus
- traditions, family occasions, food, festivals and celebrations.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use past tense for previous celebrations, present tense for customs and future tense for planned events.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.modelAnswer: In India, people decorate their homes at Diwali and eat sweets with family.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“भारत में दिवाली पर लोग घर सजाते हैं और परिवार के साथ मिठाइयाँ खाते हैं।”

Give two ways Diwali is celebrated.

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: My birthday is in April and every year I invite a few friends.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“मेरा जन्मदिन अप्रैल में है और हर साल मैं कुछ मित्रों को बुलाता हूँ।”

When is the birthday, and who is invited?

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: At Eid we prepared special food and gave sweets to neighbours.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“ईद पर हमने नया भोजन बनाया और पड़ोसियों को मिठाई दी।”

Give two things done at Eid.

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: At Holi, children wear colourful clothes and play with colours.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“होली पर बच्चे रंग-बिरंगे कपड़े पहनते हैं और रंगों से खेलते हैं।”

What do children wear and do at Holi?

questions.examTip: Read the Hindi carefully and answer with the stated detail; check नहीं, समय words, numbers and the subject of the verb.
questions.modelAnswer: Next year I will take part in the village fair with my grandparents.
questions.question:

“अगले साल मैं दादा-दादी के साथ गाँव के मेले में भाग लूँगा।”

What future celebration is planned, and with whom?

questions.modelAnswer: I like traditional festivals because they connect different generations.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Hindi sentence and answer in English:

“मुझे पारंपरिक त्योहार पसंद हैं क्योंकि वे अलग-अलग पीढ़ियों को जोड़ते हैं।”
